subject: Access evidence: session origin mapping, reprovisioning deltas, and least-privilege attestations
messages:
From: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@acmehealth.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — session origin + SCIM deltas + RBAC attestations

Hannah,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake window for the acquisition team we need a compact bundle demonstrating how Redwood handles access control for tenant-scoped users. Specifically we are asking for: 

- Session origin mapping (IP / region / device fingerprint) for privileged sessions over the last 90 days, with an explanation of retention policy.
- SCIM delta files showing reprovisioning events for the last 30 days (adds/updates/deprovision) for a sample tenant.
- The current RBAC matrix and a short attestation that role assignments follow least-privilege principles (who signs off internally).

Can you send a zipped logs bundle + a SCIM delta CSV and an internal attestation? If you prefer, we can accept redacted artifacts and a short write-up that maps the files back to your controls narrative.

Deadline: EOD Aug 25 (SIG submission).

Appreciate it —
Audrey
Security Program Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: request_spec_acme_SIG_2027.pdf (spec PDF)
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
To: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@acmehealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — session origin + SCIM deltas + RBAC attestations

Audrey —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can produce the items you listed. Quick plan: 

1) Session origin logs: Jonas will pull the 90-day bundle and redact tenant identifiers as needed. We'll include a short readme explaining retention and the mapping from session IDs -> IP/geo/device fingerprint.
2) SCIM delta: we'll export a delta CSV for a sandbox tenant (won't include PHI). It will include timestamps, action (add/update/delete), and actor.
3) RBAC matrix + attestation: Markus will attach the matrix and a signed attestation PDF from our Security Manager.

We'll use redwood-secure-drive link and provide a DocuSign envelope for the attestation. If you need raw logs instead of redacted, let us know and we'll share via a restricted S3 presigned URL.

Target: deliver initial package on Mon Aug 23, final signed attestation by Tue Aug 24 EOD. Does that timeline work for your submission?

— Hannah Schmitt
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwood.com)

Attachment: none
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@acmehealth.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — session origin + SCIM deltas + RBAC attestations

Hannah / Audrey —

I pulled the session origin bundle and a SCIM delta export from the provisioning service. Quick notes on contents: 

- session_origin_log_202706.tar.gz (log bundle): contains JSONL entries with session_id, tenant_id (redacted), timestamp, src_ip, geo (country/region), device_fingerprint. Retention policy: session metadata retained 180 days; full request traces retained 30 days. See README in the archive.
- scim_delta_202707.csv (CSV): sample 30-day delta for tenant sandbox-acme-01, includes event_type (create/update/disable), actor (system/admin/email), timestamp. We scrubbed account_level identifiers and replaced with stable pseudonyms.

I'm uploading both to the secure drive folder for Acme Health now and will share the link with the thread. If Acme needs raw tenant IDs for internal correlation we can provide them under an MOU; otherwise the redacted bundle should be sufficient for SIG reviewers.

Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Security Instrumentation
Redwood Inference

Attachments (attached to secure drive): session_origin_log_202706.tar.gz (log bundle), scim_delta_202707.csv (CSV), scim_sync_manifest.txt (sync manifest stub)
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@acmehealth.com>, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — session origin + SCIM deltas + RBAC attestations

Audrey / Hannah —

I've uploaded the RBAC matrix (rbac_matrix_redwood_v2.xlsx) and the signed least-privilege attestation (least_privilege_attestation_signed.pdf) to the same secure drive folder. Summary: 

- RBAC matrix maps roles -> permissions -> default grant rationale. Privileged roles (admin, infra-ops, support-impersonation) require manager + security approval; we call this out in the matrix and in the attestation.
- Attestation PDF is signed by our Security Manager and includes the control ID references used in your SIG questionnaire.

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/security/AcmeHealth/SIG-evidence-2027
DocuSign envelope: envelope-id-0a9f7b2d (attestation)

Let me know if you want a short crosswalk doc mapping each artifact to SIG question numbers — I can produce that by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Manager, Trust & Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded: rbac_matrix_redwood_v2.xlsx, least_privilege_attestation_signed.pdf
